verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms push-based sign-in with admin-controlled enablement (docs-3) and location-context checks for conditional access (docs-15), and community reports corroborate admin-enforced MFA policies requiring MS Authenticator push in real deployments (comm-8, comm-9). However, the evidence pack never mentions the specific 'number matching' anti-phishing mechanism, leaving a core element of the story unaddressed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of number matching as a phishing defense, and independent verification that these defenses actually block real-world phishing attempts.
